subject: Next steps: Private hosting deep dive + demo — propose times
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@cedarbridgehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 7 Sep 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Private hosting deep dive + demo — propose times

Hi Tom — great to meet earlier today. Thanks for walking us through the CedBridge deployment constraints and the primary use cases for patient-data-driven summaries. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (from our discovery)
- Primary workload: real-time summarization + embeddings for search across PHI-scoped documents (PII redaction required)
- Compliance drivers: SOC2, regionally-restricted data in our US VPC, KMS/HSM for key management
- Throughput target: 12 concurrent inference sessions at 512 tokens, 95th pct latency < 250ms

Next step: Deep technical architecture review (Private/VPC deployment) + short demo of runtime behavior and routing/fallbacks. Goals for that call:
- Validate network requirements and egress policies
- Confirm KMS/HSM integration path and key rotation cadence
- Walk through autoscaling and canary rollback behavior for model rollouts
- Show a 15-min demo of a representative request/response profile

Proposed 60-minute slots (all PT):
- Tue Sep 12, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Sep 13, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu Sep 14, 08:00–09:00 PT

Please let me know which of the above works and who on your side should attend (security, infra, app owners). Also helpful: if you can share an AWS account ID or a list of IPs that need to be allowed so we can prepare the runbook. I’ve attached our pre-demo runbook and network requirements checklist to speed prep.

If none of those times work, send a couple alternatives and we’ll do our best to accommodate.

Thanks — rachel

Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: network_requirements.pdf (stub), pre-demo-runbook.md (stub)

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@cedarbridgehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya.s@cedarbridgehealth.com>, Greg Lawson <greg.lawson@cedarbridgehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Sep 2028 13:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: Private hosting deep dive + demo — propose times

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the clear recap. We are definitely interested in the Private/VPC option; the compliance questions you outlined map to our internal checklist. 

Attendees from our side
- Tom Alvarez (CTO)
- Maya Srinivasan (Security lead)
- Greg Lawson (Infra/Cloud)

Of the proposed slots, Wed Sep 13 14:00–15:00 PT (that’s 17:00–18:00 ET) is the best for our team. 

Quick ask: can you include a brief agenda for the demo portion (15 minutes) and confirm whether you’ll need temporary access to our AWS account or if a staging VPC you provide will suffice for a live example? We’d prefer to avoid broad access for the initial deep dive — a staging VPC or redacted sample request flow would be ideal.

I’m attaching a short architecture snapshot from our infra team — it contains VPC layout and current peering/VPN config. 

Regards,
Tom

Tom Alvarez
CTO, CedarBridge Health
Tom.Alvarez@cedarbridgehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-9987

Attachments: cedarbridge_current_vpc_diagram.pdf (stub)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@cedarbridgehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 8 Sep 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Private hosting deep dive + demo — propose times

Perfect — Wed Sep 13 14:00–15:00 PT works for us. I’ve gone ahead and booked the slot: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cedarbridge-privdeepdive-20280908 (invite sent).

Agenda (60m)
- 5m: Introductions & desired outcomes
- 20m: Architecture review (VPC layout, KMS options, peering/egress patterns) — Marissa will lead
- 15m: Demo: representative request path + latency/cost tradeoffs — Ben will lead
- 10m: Integration discussion (what we need from your infra: account IDs, firewall rules, bastion/NGFW details)
- 10m: Next steps & checklist (action items, owners, timeline)

Per your note, we will plan a staging VPC demo (no production AWS access required). To make the demo concrete, it would help if you can add a short redacted sample (one request/one document) to the shared Drive folder before the call. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-priv-deepdive-runbook

I’ve attached an initial agenda PDF and re-attached the network checklist. If your team is comfortable sharing the VPC diagram (thanks) we’ll review it live and call out any gating items. 

See you Wed — rachel

Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: arch-deepdive-agenda.pdf (stub)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-priv-deepdive-runbook

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@cedarbridgehealth.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 8 Sep 2028 16:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: Private hosting deep dive + demo — propose times

Hi Tom — quick technical prep note ahead of Wed’s call:
- If you can, please paste the three CIDR ranges we should expect egress from in the shared doc; we’ll validate the firewall rules on our side.
- If you want us to show a live connection to a staging VPC, a read-only IAM role or an S3 presigned object will be enough for the demo — no admin keys needed.
- Also helpful: which KMS provider are you using today (AWS KMS, external HSM, or both) and whether you require FIPS endpoints.

If it helps, we can run a 15-minute pre-check on Tue Sep 12 to confirm connectivity (no demo, just network validation). Let me know if you want that option.

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
